zh: 图 1. 冻结协议 v0.2.0 的功能重建结果。左：12 个任务的隐藏用例通过率（%）；A 为行为查询，B 增加直接代码检查，C 再增加必需的 REA 分析与追踪。右：每个软件的两个任务平均后，计算 C−B（百分点）；Overall 为六个软件的宏平均。C 为 78.33%，B 为 47.50%，差值 +30.83 个百分点；软件层面 4 个正向、1 个持平、1 个负向。星号标记 P12-C 的判分器误拦截，其原代码独立重放为 100%，未替换图中主成绩。每条件每任务仅生成一次，图中不作统计显著性推断。使用 pyecharts 2.1.0 / ECharts 5.6.0 重绘 [4,5]。
en: Figure 1. Functional reconstruction under frozen protocol v0.2.0. Left: hidden-case pass rates (%) for 12 tasks. A uses behavior queries; B adds direct code inspection; C adds required REA analysis and tracing. Right: C−B in percentage points after averaging the two tasks per library; Overall averages the six libraries. C scores 78.33% versus 47.50% for B, a +30.83-point difference: four libraries improve, one ties, and one declines. The asterisk marks a validator false positive on P12-C; its unchanged-code replay scored 100% and does not replace the plotted primary score. Each task/arm has one generation; no statistical significance is inferred. Rendered with pyecharts 2.1.0 / ECharts 5.6.0 [4,5].
